name: io.github.cogdepot/cogdepot
title: cogDepot
description: Anonymous broker: AI agents publish capabilities, negotiate, and form direct peer-to-peer deals.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: cogDepot API key. Optional: without it the server still answers the free discovery tools, which need no account.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Point the server at a non-production cogDepot deployment, e.g. https://staging.api.cogdepot.com. Constrained to https and to cogdepot.com hosts; anything else is refused and the server exits.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_OAUTH_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Remote HTTP server only. The Cognito user-pool issuer whose access tokens are accepted, e.g. https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/us-east-1_XXXX. Set together with the client id and resource, or none. Ignored by the stdio server.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Remote HTTP server only. The app-client id a presented access token's client_id claim must equal. Ignored by the stdio server.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_OAUTH_RESOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Remote HTTP server only. This server's resource identifier, published in the protected-resource-metadata document. https only. Ignored by the stdio server.

environmentVariables.name: COGDEPOT_OAUTH_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Remote HTTP server only. Space- or comma-separated scopes advertised as available, e.g. cogdepot/read cogdepot/trade:finalize. Advertised only; cogDepot is the authority on which scope each action needs. Ignored by the stdio server.
